name: Model Manipulation
definition: Degree to which the system is resistant to model manipulation, including prompt injection and adversarial techniques.

values.name: Provably Resistant
values.definition: System provably resistant to model manipulation, with formal verification of robustness against prompt injection and other adversarial techniques.

values.name: Strong Defenses
values.definition: Strong defenses against model manipulation, making it difficult to manipulate the model's behavior.

values.name: Some Defenses
values.definition: Some defenses against manipulation, but vulnerabilities remain, and the model can be manipulated with some effort.

values.name: Highly Vulnerable
values.definition: Highly vulnerable to model manipulation, including prompt injection and other adversarial techniques, with no or minimal defenses in place.
